notes.title: The preview version of the New Map is released
notes.notes:
Good afternoon players, and now the preview version of the new map finally allows players to experience it.

Players can experience in the library by right-click on the national war -> Properties -> Test -> newchinamap.

Map content has been basically completed, there are currently a total of 255 cities and about 170 countries.

(Note: Currently, we are working overtime to find a solution due to some issues that only support 64-bit systems for the new map.)
